# Cleaning

```{r}

# Select play id and pass info to merge with the field control data frame
# Also keep targeted receiver info to understand where the receiver is located at the time of the throw
pass_info <- main %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, frame_id, phase, pass_result, ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std, los_x_std,
         player_role, x_std, y_std) %>%
  filter(player_role == "Targeted Receiver", phase == "pre_pass") %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id) %>%
  filter(frame_id == max(frame_id)) %>%
  ungroup()


```

# WR Location Analysis

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(quantreg)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)

# =============================================================================
# 1. TRAIN / TEST SPLIT (80% Train, 20% Test)
# =============================================================================
# Model absolute error values for symmetric radii
processed_data <- completed_pass_bounds %>%
  mutate(
    abs_err_x = abs(err_x),
    abs_err_y = abs(err_y)
  )

train_idx  <- sample(seq_len(nrow(processed_data)), size = floor(0.80 * nrow(processed_data)))
train_data <- processed_data[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- processed_data[-train_idx, ]

# =============================================================================
# 2. DEFINE CANDIDATE SEQUENCES & PRE-COMPUTE PREDICTIONS
# =============================================================================
tau_x_cand <- seq(0.85, 0.995, by = 0.005)
tau_y_cand <- seq(0.85, 0.995, by = 0.005)

# Train models ON TRAIN DATA and generate predictions for BOTH Train and Test sets
preds_x_train <- map(tau_x_cand, ~ pmax(predict(rq(abs_err_x ~ receiver_depth, tau = .x, data = train_data, method = "fn")), 0.1))
preds_x_test  <- map(tau_x_cand, ~ pmax(predict(rq(abs_err_x ~ receiver_depth, tau = .x, data = train_data, method = "fn"), newdata = test_data), 0.1))
names(preds_x_train) <- names(preds_x_test) <- as.character(tau_x_cand)

preds_y_train <- map(tau_y_cand, ~ pmax(predict(rq(abs_err_y ~ receiver_depth, tau = .x, data = train_data, method = "fn")), 0.1))
preds_y_test  <- map(tau_y_cand, ~ pmax(predict(rq(abs_err_y ~ receiver_depth, tau = .x, data = train_data, method = "fn"), newdata = test_data), 0.1))
names(preds_y_train) <- names(preds_y_test) <- as.character(tau_y_cand)

# =============================================================================
# 3. EVALUATE ALL PAIRS ON TRAIN AND TEST SETS
# =============================================================================
tau_grid <- expand_grid(tau_x = tau_x_cand, tau_y = tau_y_cand)

eval_grid <- map2_dfr(tau_grid$tau_x, tau_grid$tau_y, function(tx, ty) {
  # --- Training Predictions & Metrics ---
  rx_train <- preds_x_train[[as.character(tx)]]
  ry_train <- preds_y_train[[as.character(ty)]]
  in_ellipse_train <- ((train_data$err_x / rx_train)^2 + (train_data$err_y / ry_train)^2) <= 1.0
  
  # --- Testing Predictions & Metrics ---
  rx_test  <- preds_x_test[[as.character(tx)]]
  ry_test  <- preds_y_test[[as.character(ty)]]
  in_ellipse_test  <- ((test_data$err_x / rx_test)^2 + (test_data$err_y / ry_test)^2) <= 1.0
  
  tibble(
    tau_x = tx,
    tau_y = ty,
    
    # IN-SAMPLE METRICS (Used for Decision Making)
    train_coverage = mean(in_ellipse_train),
    train_avg_area = mean(pi * rx_train * ry_train),
    
    # OUT-OF-SAMPLE METRICS (Used for Validation)
    test_coverage  = mean(in_ellipse_test),
    test_avg_area  = mean(pi * rx_test * ry_test)
  )
})

# =============================================================================
# 4. PARETO FRONTIER & SELECTION (BASED STRICTLY ON TRAIN METRICS)
# =============================================================================
pareto_frontier <- eval_grid %>%
  arrange(train_avg_area) %>%
  mutate(max_train_cov_so_far = cummax(train_coverage)) %>%
  filter(train_coverage == max_train_cov_so_far) %>%
  distinct(train_coverage, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    d_cov = train_coverage - lag(train_coverage),
    d_area = train_avg_area - lag(train_avg_area),
    train_efficiency = d_cov / d_area
  )

# Select optimal combination using TRAIN efficiency (Gated at >= 90% Train Coverage)
best_gated_tau <- pareto_frontier %>%
  filter(train_coverage >= 0.90) %>%
  arrange(desc(train_efficiency)) %>%
  slice(1)

# Print comparison between Train selection and Test validation
cat("--- OPTIMAL PARAMETER SELECTION & GENERALIZATION TEST ---\n")
best_gated_tau %>%
  select(
    tau_x, tau_y, 
    train_coverage, test_coverage, 
    train_avg_area, test_avg_area, 
    train_efficiency
  ) %>%
  print()

# =============================================================================
# 5. PLOT TRAIN PARETO FRONTIER WITH TEST OVERLAY
# =============================================================================
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = eval_grid, aes(x = train_avg_area, y = train_coverage), color = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = pareto_frontier, aes(x = train_avg_area, y = train_coverage), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = best_gated_tau, aes(x = train_avg_area, y = train_coverage), color = "red", size = 4) +
  geom_point(data = best_gated_tau, aes(x = test_avg_area, y = test_coverage), color = "darkgreen", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Pareto Frontier (Chosen on Train Data)",
    subtitle = "Red dot = Chosen Train Performance | Green dot = Validation Test Performance",
    x = "Average Ellipse Area (sq yards)",
    y = "Completed Passes Captured (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# =============================================================================
# 6. FIT FINAL PRODUCTION MODELS ON FULL DATASET
# =============================================================================
qr_x_final <- rq(abs_err_x ~ receiver_depth, tau = best_gated_tau$tau_x, data = processed_data, method = "fn")
qr_y_final <- rq(abs_err_y ~ receiver_depth, tau = best_gated_tau$tau_y, data = processed_data, method = "fn")

cat("\n--- FINAL PRODUCTION COEFFICIENTS ---\n")
cat("Vertical Semi-Axis (Rx) Coefficients:\n")
print(coef(qr_x_final))

cat("\nHorizontal Semi-Axis (Ry) Coefficients:\n")
print(coef(qr_y_final))

```

# Plot

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(quantreg)
library(tidyr)

# 2. Sample 9 distinct plays and calculate dynamic semi-axes (R_x, R_y)
set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducible sample selection
sample_plays <- completed_pass_bounds %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 9) %>%
  mutate(
    play_label = paste0("Game: ", game_id, " | Play: ", play_id),
    r_x = pmax(predict(qr_x_final, newdata = .), 0.1),
    r_y = pmax(predict(qr_y_final, newdata = .), 0.1)
  )

# 3. Generate 360-degree boundary ellipse coordinates for each play
theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 100)

ellipse_points <- sample_plays %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    play_label = play_label,
    ellipse_x = x_std + r_x * cos(theta),
    ellipse_y = y_std + r_y * sin(theta)
  )

# 4. Generate 3x3 faceted plot
ggplot() +
  # Line of Scrimmage (LOS)
  geom_vline(
    data = sample_plays, 
    aes(xintercept = los_x_std, linetype = "Line of Scrimmage"), 
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # Dynamic Elliptical Throw Boundary Zone
  geom_polygon(
    data = ellipse_points, 
    aes(x = ellipse_x, y = ellipse_y, group = play_label, fill = "Throw Boundary Zone"), 
    color = "#2563eb", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  # Targeted Receiver Location
  geom_point(
    data = sample_plays, 
    aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, color = "Targeted Receiver"), 
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  # Ball Landing Location
  geom_point(
    data = sample_plays, 
    aes(x = ball_land_x_std, y = ball_land_y_std, color = "Ball Landing Spot"), 
    shape = 4, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  # Aesthetics and Styling
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Key Locations",
    values = c("Targeted Receiver" = "#16a34a", "Ball Landing Spot" = "#dc2626")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Boundary Area",
    values = c("Throw Boundary Zone" = "#3b82f6")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Field Markers",
    values = c("Line of Scrimmage" = "dashed")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ play_label, ncol = 3) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Targeted Throw Bounds Across 9 Sampled Plays",
    subtitle = expression(paste("Elliptical boundaries scaled by receiver depth (", tau[x] == 0.945, ", ", tau[y] == 0.990, ")")),
    x = "Field X (Standardized Yards)",
    y = "Field Y (Standardized Yards)"
  )

```
